Name: Stardew Merge
Author: slpOff
Description:
[size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size]

Stardew Merge is a SMAPI mod that lets you customize game textures through a browser-based image editor.

Choose an in-game texture, select part of a retexture image, and merge it into the desired location. Combine your favorite pieces from different retextures and check the results in-game without restarting.


[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Side-by-side views of the target texture and source image.[/*]
[*]Game texture selection by folder, subfolder, and image name.[/*]
[*]Area selection and precise placement.[/*]
[*]Overlay and Replace merge modes.[/*]
[*]Adjustable grid size and grid snapping.[/*]
[*]Zoom and pan controls.[/*]
[*]Undo and redo.[/*]
[*]Load saved merged images and restore the original texture.[/*]
[*]Preview texture changes in-game without restarting.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*]SMAPI.[/*]
[*]A web browser.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract Stardew Merge.[/*]
[*]Place the mod folder inside your game's [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Put the retexture images you want to use in [b]stardewmerge/stardewmerge/assets[/b].
- you can put it while using web editor.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]How to Use[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Enter [b]mopen[/b] in the SMAPI console to open the web editor.[/*]
[*]In the left panel, select the game texture you want to edit using the folder, subfolder, and image dropdowns.[/*]
[*]In the right panel, select a source image from your [b]assets[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Drag over the source image to select the area you want to use.[/*]
[*]Choose the destination on the left image. Adjust the grid size and enable grid snapping when needed.[/*]
[*]Click [b]Overlay[/b] or [b]Replace[/b] to merge the selected area.[/*]
[*]Check the result, then click [b]Save[/b].[/*]
[*]Return to the game to view the updated texture without restarting.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Example: Retexturing a Crab Pot[/b]

Select [b]Maps → No subfolder → springobjects[/b] in the left panel. Select your Crab Pot retexture in the right panel, choose the replacement artwork, and merge it into the Crab Pot sprite area.


[size=5][b]Merge Modes[/b][/size]

[b]Overlay[/b]
Draws the selected image over the existing texture. Transparent areas preserve the pixels underneath.

[b]Replace[/b]
Replaces the destination area, including transparent pixels. Use this to remove the old artwork completely within that area.


[size=5][b]Editor Controls[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]V:[/b] Switch to selection mode.[/*]
[*][b]M:[/b] Switch to move mode.[/*]
[*][b]Mouse wheel:[/b] Zoom in or out around the pointer.[/*]
[*][b]Space + drag:[/b] Pan the image.[/*]
[/list]
Use [b]Undo[/b] and [b]Redo[/b] to adjust recent edits, [b]Saved Merged Image[/b] to load an existing result, or [b]Restore Original[/b] to revert the texture.


[size=5][b]Asset Permissions[/b][/size]

Please respect the permissions set by the original retexture creators. Merging images does not grant permission to redistribute them.

Before sharing a merged texture, check each creator's terms and obtain permission where required.
